What we do

Services

Every engagement ends with a clear report and a fix list your team can act on — and we retest for free once the fixes are in.

01

Security testing

We attack your systems the way real hackers would, then show you exactly how to fix what we found.

  • Web & API penetration testing →
  • Mobile app penetration testing →
  • Network & infrastructure testing →
  • AI & LLM security testing →
02

Monitoring & response

We watch your systems around the clock and act the moment something looks wrong.

  • Continuous monitoring →
  • Incident response →
  • Threat hunting →
03

Code & cloud review

We check the code and cloud setup you already have for the mistakes attackers look for.

  • Secure code review →

  • Infrastructure hardening →
04

Advisory & training

  • Compliance readiness →
  • Risk mitigation roadmaps →

How we work

Simple to start.
Clear at every step.

From finding the issue to fixing it — a straightforward process, built for real-world security.

  1. 01

    We find what's exposed

    Every system of yours that can be reached from the internet — including the ones nobody remembers.

  2. 02

    We test it like an attacker would

    We try to break in, safely, and show you exactly how far a real attacker could get.

  3. 03

    We help you fix it, then check again

    A clear fix list for your team, a free retest, and an alert when something new is exposed.
